mapper.insert: INSERT INTO luck_agent_knowledge (title, type, question, content, enabled, embedding_status, error_msg, source_filename, file_path, file_size, file_type, splitter_type, model_id, is_deleted, is_resource_cleaned, created_time, updated_time) VALUES (#{title}, #{type}, #{question}, #{content}, #{enabled}, #{embeddingStatus}, #{errorMsg}, #{sourceFilename}, #{filePath}, #{fileSize}, #{fileType}, #{splitterType}, #{modelId}, #{isDeleted}, #{isResourceCleaned}, #{createdTime}, #{updatedTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, title, type, question, content, enabled, embedding_status, error_msg, source_filename, file_path, file_size, file_type, splitter_type, model_id, is_deleted, is_resource_cleaned, created_time, updated_time FROM luck_agent_knowledge WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
